walkthroughs.body_html:
Beddington Zero Energy Development — 100 homes in Sutton (opened 2002).

Features: south-facing windows, super-insulation, rooftop solar, rainwater harvesting, distinctive coloured wind cowls for ventilation.

Residents use ~50% less energy than the UK average.

Curitiba (Brazil) pioneered Bus Rapid Transit in the 1970s.

Bendy buses in dedicated lanes, tube-shaped boarding stations for fast loading, single flat fare.

Around 70% of commuters use the BRT — cutting traffic and emissions massively.

Curitiba also runs Green Exchange: residents of favelas swap bags of rubbish for fresh vegetables — boosting recycling AND nutrition.

The city has over 50 m² of green space per person.

Lessons: clever planning beats expensive concrete every time.

Sustainable development means stopping all economic growth.
Sustainable development means using only solar power.
Development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs — balancing economic, social and environmental goals.
Informal settlements are built by the government for new migrants.

mcqs.q: Why do informal settlements develop in rapidly growing LIC cities?
options: People live in slums because they prefer them or are too lazy to find better housing.
Informal settlements are built by the government for new migrants.
Sustainable development means using only solar power.
Rural-urban migration outpaces formal housing supply; migrants build their own homes on marginal land without secure land tenure — driven by housing shortage, not by personal choice.

mcqs.q: Why do people move from rural to urban areas in LICs?
options: Because the government forces them to move to cities.
Because cities in poor countries are always better than the countryside.
A combination of push factors (rural poverty, lack of services, agricultural change) and pull factors (perceived jobs, education, healthcare) — though reality often disappoints.
Informal settlements are built by the government for new migrants.
